description: This file defines the ExtNode class, which models a node in a tree view for the SuiteCRM application. It includes properties for node attributes, child nodes, and methods for setting properties, adding child nodes, and generating the node's definition for JavaScript rendering.

classes.name: ExtNode
classes.description: A class representing a node in a tree view with properties for label, id, child nodes, and methods to manage these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an ExtNode instance with an id, label, and optional expanded state.

methods.name: set_property
methods.description: Sets a property for the node, optionally as a parameter.

methods.name: add_node
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node.

methods.name: get_definition
methods.description: Returns an array representing the node's definition for use in rendering the tree, including children.
